notes.title: DEV DIARY#1
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=h6bgLvDRZ3s;full][/previewyoutube]
The list of changes:
- We have improved the animations for walking, running, and turning.
- A new animation system has been added that links the movements of the pelvis during attacks with simultaneous movement in any direction.
- The system of bounces and reactions to hits on players and weapons has been refined.
- When weapons get stuck, the behavior of sagging limbs and the response of the character's skeleton to the grip point has been improved.
- With a kick, players can now knock down an attacker's attacks or create more space for a counterattack.
